services.title: What We Do
services.subtitle: Full-cycle Bitrix24: implementation, customization, automation, integrations, and custom development.
services.intro: We adapt Bitrix24 to your processes so your team can work in one place, reduce manual work, and keep every stage transparent.

items.title: Installation & Setup
items.description: We launch Bitrix24 from zero: setup, migration from spreadsheets or other CRMs, security, and permissions. Your team gets a clean, structured workspace from day one.

items.title: Customization
items.description: We shape Bitrix24 around your sales and operations: custom fields, pipelines, roles, and screens. The system matches how your team works, not the other way around.

items.title: Technical Support
items.description: Ongoing help when you need it: diagnostics, updates, fixes, and best practices. Support priority and response times depend on your plan.

items.title: Training & Consulting
items.description: We train your team and align processes so adoption is fast and usage is effective from day one.

items.title: Automation
items.description: We design automation for sales, marketing, and internal workflows so repetitive tasks run on their own and your team can focus on decisions.

items.title: Integration
items.description: We connect Bitrix24 with ERP, email, telephony, e-commerce, or custom apps via API so data flows in one direction and stays in sync.

items.title: Application Development
items.description: We build custom modules, mobile extensions, and portal add-ons when standard Bitrix24 features are not enough.

process.title: How We Work
process.subtitle: A clear path from first contact to a running system and ongoing support

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: We discuss your goals, current tools, and processes. You get a clear picture of what Bitrix24 can do and what we recommend for your case.

steps.title: Planning
steps.description: We agree on scope, timelines, and deliverables. You see the plan before we start so there are no surprises.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.description: We set up and customize Bitrix24: data migration, pipelines, automation, and integrations according to the plan.

steps.title: Training
steps.description: We train your team so they can use the system confidently from day one. Materials and follow-up Q&A are included.

steps.title: Support
steps.description: After go-live we stay available for questions, fixes, and improvements. You can extend support as your needs grow.
